```python
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Prepare the data: Count the number of dogs per breed
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)

# Plot
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')

# Add titles and labels
plt.title('Top 10 Most Common Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Number of Registered Dogs', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Dog Breed', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
